name: Motion for a resolution
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the draft Commission regulation amending Annex II to Regulation (EC) No 396/2005 of the European Parliament and of the Council as regards maximum residue levels for acetamiprid, aclonifen, deltamethrin, oxathiapiprolin and potassium phosphonates in or on certain products
part_text:
The European Parliament is asking the European Commission to withdraw its plan to allow more of a pesticide called acetamiprid on honey. The plan would raise the allowed residue level in honey to 1 mg per kg, after an earlier rise in July 2025. Parliament says the pesticide may harm developing brains and bees, and that the science is still uncertain. It wants a new plan that lowers the allowed levels instead.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament rejects the plan and asks for it to be withdrawn and replaced with lower limits.
- **Who it affects:** Beekeepers, honey consumers, farmers using this pesticide, and bees and wild pollinators.
- **What happens next:** The Commission must decide whether to withdraw the plan. Parliament's position is not binding.
